sections.title: Gap 3 — `FirebaseTokenVerifier`: no spec at all
sections.content:
This is a security boundary — it needs coverage. The cert fetch and JWT decode are both untested.

```ruby

sections.title: spec/services/firebase_token_verifier_spec.rb
sections.content:
require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe FirebaseTokenVerifier do
  let(:project_id) { "test-project" }

  before { stub_const("ENV", ENV.to_h.merge("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID" => project_id)) }

  describe ".verify" do
    context "with a malformed token" do
      it "returns nil without raising" do
        expect(FirebaseTokenVerifier.verify("not.a.jwt")).to be_nil
      end
    end

    context "when Google certificate fetch fails" do
      before do
        stub_request(:get, FirebaseTokenVerifier::CERT_URL)
          .to_return(status: 503, body: "")
        Rails.cache.clear
      end

      it "returns nil (does not let a network failure through)" do
        # Can't verify without certs — safe to reject
        expect(FirebaseTokenVerifier.verify("header.payload.sig")).to be_nil
      end
    end

    context "when kid is not in Google's certificate list" do
      before do
        stub_request(:get, FirebaseTokenVerifier::CERT_URL)
          .to_return(status: 200, body: { "other_kid" => "cert" }.to_json)
        Rails.cache.clear
        allow(JWT).to receive(:decode).and_return([{}, { "kid" => "missing_kid" }])
      end

      it "returns nil" do
        expect(FirebaseTokenVerifier.verify("a.b.c")).to be_nil
      end
    end

    context "with a valid signed token" do
      # Integration-level: generate a real RSA keypair, self-sign a cert, issue a JWT.
      let(:key) { OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.generate(2048) }
      let(:kid) { "test-kid-1" }
      let(:cert) do
        c = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new
        c.subject = c.issuer = OpenSSL::X509::Name.parse("CN=test")
        c.public_key = key.public_key
        c.serial = 0; c.version = 2
        c.not_before = Time.now; c.not_after = Time.now + 3600
        c.sign(key, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new)
        c
      end

      before do
        stub_request(:get, FirebaseTokenVerifier::CERT_URL)
          .to_return(status: 200, body: { kid => cert.to_pem }.to_json)
        Rails.cache.clear
      end

      let(:token) do
        payload = {
          sub: "uid_abc", aud: project_id,
          iss: "https://securetoken.google.com/#{project_id}",
          iat: Time.now.to_i, exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600
        }
        JWT.encode(payload, key, "RS256", { kid: kid })
      end

      it "returns the decoded payload" do
        result = FirebaseTokenVerifier.verify(token)
        expect(result).to include("sub" => "uid_abc")
      end
    end
  end
end
```

sections.title: Gap 4 — `PaystackService`: no spec
sections.content:
Critical money path. The `billing_spec.rb` stubs at the HTTP level but never tests `PaystackService` in isolation.

```ruby

sections.title: spec/services/paystack_service_spec.rb
sections.content:
require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe PaystackService do
  let(:user) { build(:user, email: "pay@example.com") }

  before do
    stub_const("ENV", ENV.to_h.merge(
      "PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY"        => "pk_test",
      "PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY"        => "sk_test",
      "PAYSTACK_MONTHLY_PLAN_CODE" => "PLN_monthly",
      "PAYSTACK_YEARLY_PLAN_CODE"  => "PLN_yearly"
    ))
  end

  describe "#initialize_subscription" do
    it "returns the authorization_url on success" do
      stub_request(:post, "https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize")
        .to_return(status: 200,
                   body: { status: true, data: { authorization_url: "https://checkout.paystack.com/x" } }.to_json)

      url = PaystackService.new.initialize_subscription(user, callback_url: "https://app.test/billing/callback")
      expect(url).to eq("https://checkout.paystack.com/x")
    end

    it "raises ConfigurationError when credentials are missing" do
      stub_const("ENV", {})
      expect { PaystackService.new.initialize_subscription(user, callback_url: "/") }
        .to raise_error(PaystackService::ConfigurationError)
    end

    it "uses the yearly plan code when plan: 'yearly' is passed" do
      req = stub_request(:post, "https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize")
        .with(body: hash_including("plan" => "PLN_yearly"))
        .to_return(status: 200, body: { status: true, data: { authorization_url: "https://x.paystack.com" } }.to_json)

      PaystackService.new.initialize_subscription(user, callback_url: "/", plan: "yearly")
      expect(req).to have_been_requested
    end
  end

  describe "#verify_transaction" do
    it "returns transaction data for a successful charge" do
      stub_request(:get, /api.paystack.co\/transaction\/verify/)
        .to_return(status: 200,
                   body: { status: true, data: { status: "success", id: 99 } }.to_json)

      result = PaystackService.new.verify_transaction("ref_abc")
      expect(result).to include("status" => "success")
    end

    it "returns false when the charge failed" do
      stub_request(:get, /api.paystack.co\/transaction\/verify/)
        .to_return(status: 200,
                   body: { status: true, data: { status: "failed" } }.to_json)

      expect(PaystackService.new.verify_transaction("ref_abc")).to be false
    end

    it "returns false on network error (never raises)" do
      stub_request(:get, /api.paystack.co\/transaction\/verify/).to_raise(StandardError)
      expect(PaystackService.new.verify_transaction("ref_bad")).to be false
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby

sections.title: spec/services/tool_registry_spec.rb
sections.content:
require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe ToolRegistry do
  describe ".find" do
    it "returns a tool hash by id" do
      t = ToolRegistry.find("merge_pdf")
      expect(t[:class_name]).to eq("Tools::MergePdf")
      expect(t[:accepts_multiple]).to be true
    end

    it "returns nil for an unknown id" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.find("not_a_tool")).to be_nil
    end
  end

  describe ".all" do
    it "contains 27 tools" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.all.size).to eq(27)
    end

    it "every tool has the required keys" do
      required = %i[id name description category icon class_name]
      ToolRegistry.all.each do |tool|
        missing = required - tool.keys
        expect(missing).to be_empty, "#{tool[:id]} is missing: #{missing}"
      end
    end
  end

  describe ".group_for" do
    it "returns the correct group for known tools" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("merge_pdf")).to eq("PDF Tools")
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("heic_to_jpg")).to eq("Images")
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("summarize_pdf")).to eq("AI Documents")
    end

    it "returns 'Other' for unregistered ids" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("nonexistent")).to eq("Other")
    end
  end

  describe ".file_tool_index" do
    it "excludes prompt-input tools (ai_generate_*)" do
      ids = ToolRegistry.file_tool_index.map { |t| t[:id] }
      expect(ids).not_to include("ai_generate_pptx", "ai_generate_docx")
    end

    it "excludes url-input tools (webpage_to_pdf)" do
      ids = ToolRegistry.file_tool_index.map { |t| t[:id] }
      expect(ids).not_to include("webpage_to_pdf")
    end

    it "includes file-accepting tools with their MIME types" do
      t = ToolRegistry.file_tool_index.find { |x| x[:id] == "compress_pdf" }
      expect(t[:accepts]).to include("application/pdf")
    end
  end

  describe ".options_for" do
    it "returns compress quality options" do
      opts = ToolRegistry.options_for("compress_pdf")
      keys = opts.map { |o| o[:key] }
      expect(keys).to include(:quality)
    end

    it "returns an empty array for tools with no options" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.options_for("pdf_to_text")).to eq([])
    end
  end
end
```

```ruby

sections.content:
require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe SeoHelper, type: :helper do
  describe "#canonical_url" do
    it "strips query params" do
      allow(helper).to receive(:request).and_return(
        double(path: "/tools/merge-pdf?utm_source=email")
      )
      expect(helper.canonical_url).to eq("https://officedoctools.com/tools/merge-pdf")
    end

    it "uses the explicit path argument over request.path" do
      expect(helper.canonical_url("/about")).to eq("https://officedoctools.com/about")
    end
  end

  describe "#breadcrumb_schema" do
    it "returns a valid BreadcrumbList structure" do
      schema = helper.breadcrumb_schema([["Home", "https://x.com/"], ["Tools", "https://x.com/tools"]])
      expect(schema["@type"]).to eq("BreadcrumbList")
      expect(schema["itemListElement"].size).to eq(2)
      expect(schema["itemListElement"][0]["position"]).to eq(1)
      expect(schema["itemListElement"][1]["name"]).to eq("Tools")
    end
  end

  describe "#faq_schema" do
    it "returns a valid FAQPage structure" do
      schema = helper.faq_schema([["Is it free?", "Yes."]])
      expect(schema["@type"]).to eq("FAQPage")
      expect(schema["mainEntity"][0]["name"]).to eq("Is it free?")
      expect(schema["mainEntity"][0]["acceptedAnswer"]["text"]).to eq("Yes.")
    end
  end

  describe "#tool_seo" do
    let(:tool) { ToolRegistry.find("compress_pdf") }

    it "generates title, description, and faq" do
      seo = helper.tool_seo(tool)
      expect(seo[:title]).to include("Compress PDF")
      expect(seo[:description].length).to be <= 158
      expect(seo[:faq]).to be_an(Array)
      expect(seo[:faq].first[0]).to match(/free/i)
    end

    it "marks premium tools with upgrade language in the faq" do
      ocr = ToolRegistry.find("ocr_pdf")
      seo = helper.tool_seo(ocr)
      expect(seo[:faq].first[1]).to include("Pro")
    end
  end
end
```

sections.title: `ToolJob` — retry exhaustion refunds quota
sections.content: ```ruby

sections.title: Add to spec/jobs/tool_job_spec.rb
sections.content:
it "refunds quota on retry exhaustion (StandardError discard)" do
  user = create(:user, conversions_count: 3)
  conversion = Conversion.create!(user: user, tool_name: "Tools::CompressPdf",
                                  status: :pending, usage_counted: true)
  fake = instance_double(Tools::CompressPdf)
  allow(Tools::CompressPdf).to receive(:new).and_return(fake)
  allow(fake).to receive(:call).and_raise(StandardError, "network blip")

  # Simulate job performing after max retries exceeded (executes_discard_on path)
  job = ToolJob.new
  job.executions = ToolJob::MAX_RETRIES + 1
  job.perform(conversion.id)

  expect(user.reload.conversions_count).to eq(2)
end
```

sections.title: Gap 10 — Integration: end-to-end conversion flow
sections.content:
No test covers upload → enqueue → process → status poll → download. This is the core product flow.

```ruby

sections.title: spec/integration/conversion_flow_spec.rb
sections.content:
require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe "Conversion end-to-end flow", type: :request do
  let(:user) { create(:user, plan: :free, confirmed_at: Time.current) }

  it "creates a conversion, jobs complete it, user can download" do
    sign_in user

    pdf_upload = fixture_file_upload('spec/fixtures/files/real.pdf', 'application/pdf')

    # Stub the tool to succeed without actual Ghostscript
    fake_tool = instance_double(Tools::CompressPdf)
    allow(Tools::CompressPdf).to receive(:new).and_return(fake_tool)
    allow(fake_tool).to receive(:call) do |*|
      Conversion.last.update!(status: :completed)
    end

    post conversions_path, params: { tool_id: "compress_pdf", files: [pdf_upload] }
    expect(response).to have_http_status(:redirect)

    conversion_id = Conversion.last.id
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    get conversion_path(conversion_id)
    expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
    expect(response.body).to include("completed")
  end
end
```

sections.title: Priority ranking
sections.content:
| Priority | Gap | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| P0 | `FirebaseTokenVerifier` | Auth bypass = security hole |
| P0 | Admin `require_admin!` | Privilege escalation if misconfigured |
| P1 | `PaystackService` | Money path, untested in isolation |
| P1 | `Webhooks::Paystack` subscription.disable | Revenue leak if lapsed subs stay active |
| P2 | `ToolRegistry` | Used in routing + SEO; silent regressions |
| P2 | `SeoHelper` JSON-LD | SEO regressions are invisible in tests |
| P3 | `ConversionMailer` | Broken emails are user-visible |
| P3 | `User.from_omniauth` | Google login entirely untested |
| P4 | `AnalyticsEvent` model | Minimal logic, low blast radius |
| P4 | Integration flow | Nice-to-have; unit coverage is sufficient |

  let(:user) { build(:user, email: "pay@example.com") }

  before do
    stub_const("ENV", ENV.to_h.merge(
      "PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY"        => "pk_test",
      "PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY"        => "sk_test",
      "PAYSTACK_MONTHLY_PLAN_CODE" => "PLN_monthly",
      "PAYSTACK_YEARLY_PLAN_CODE"  => "PLN_yearly"
    ))
  end

  describe "#initialize_subscription" do
    it "returns the authorization_url on success" do
      stub_request(:post, "https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize")
        .to_return(status: 200,
                   body: { status: true, data: { authorization_url: "https://checkout.paystack.com/x" } }.to_json)

      url = PaystackService.new.initialize_subscription(user, callback_url: "https://app.test/billing/callback")
      expect(url).to eq("https://checkout.paystack.com/x")
    end

    it "raises ConfigurationError when credentials are missing" do
      stub_const("ENV", {})
      expect { PaystackService.new.initialize_subscription(user, callback_url: "/") }
        .to raise_error(PaystackService::ConfigurationError)
    end

    it "uses the yearly plan code when plan: 'yearly' is passed" do
      req = stub_request(:post, "https://api.paystack.co/transaction/initialize")
        .with(body: hash_including("plan" => "PLN_yearly"))
        .to_return(status: 200, body: { status: true, data: { authorization_url: "https://x.paystack.com" } }.to_json)

      PaystackService.new.initialize_subscription(user, callback_url: "/", plan: "yearly")
      expect(req).to have_been_requested
    end
  end

  describe "#verify_transaction" do
    it "returns transaction data for a successful charge" do
      stub_request(:get, /api.paystack.co\/transaction\/verify/)
        .to_return(status: 200,
                   body: { status: true, data: { status: "success", id: 99 } }.to_json)

      result = PaystackService.new.verify_transaction("ref_abc")
      expect(result).to include("status" => "success")
    end

    it "returns false when the charge failed" do
      stub_request(:get, /api.paystack.co\/transaction\/verify/)
        .to_return(status: 200,
                   body: { status: true, data: { status: "failed" } }.to_json)

      expect(PaystackService.new.verify_transaction("ref_abc")).to be false
    end

    it "returns false on network error (never raises)" do
      stub_request(:get, /api.paystack.co\/transaction\/verify/).to_raise(StandardError)
      expect(PaystackService.new.verify_transaction("ref_bad")).to be false
    end
  end
end

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe ToolRegistry do
  describe ".find" do
    it "returns a tool hash by id" do
      t = ToolRegistry.find("merge_pdf")
      expect(t[:class_name]).to eq("Tools::MergePdf")
      expect(t[:accepts_multiple]).to be true
    end

    it "returns nil for an unknown id" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.find("not_a_tool")).to be_nil
    end
  end

  describe ".all" do
    it "contains 27 tools" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.all.size).to eq(27)
    end

    it "every tool has the required keys" do
      required = %i[id name description category icon class_name]
      ToolRegistry.all.each do |tool|
        missing = required - tool.keys
        expect(missing).to be_empty, "#{tool[:id]} is missing: #{missing}"
      end
    end
  end

  describe ".group_for" do
    it "returns the correct group for known tools" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("merge_pdf")).to eq("PDF Tools")
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("heic_to_jpg")).to eq("Images")
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("summarize_pdf")).to eq("AI Documents")
    end

    it "returns 'Other' for unregistered ids" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.group_for("nonexistent")).to eq("Other")
    end
  end

  describe ".file_tool_index" do
    it "excludes prompt-input tools (ai_generate_*)" do
      ids = ToolRegistry.file_tool_index.map { |t| t[:id] }
      expect(ids).not_to include("ai_generate_pptx", "ai_generate_docx")
    end

    it "excludes url-input tools (webpage_to_pdf)" do
      ids = ToolRegistry.file_tool_index.map { |t| t[:id] }
      expect(ids).not_to include("webpage_to_pdf")
    end

    it "includes file-accepting tools with their MIME types" do
      t = ToolRegistry.file_tool_index.find { |x| x[:id] == "compress_pdf" }
      expect(t[:accepts]).to include("application/pdf")
    end
  end

  describe ".options_for" do
    it "returns compress quality options" do
      opts = ToolRegistry.options_for("compress_pdf")
      keys = opts.map { |o| o[:key] }
      expect(keys).to include(:quality)
    end

    it "returns an empty array for tools with no options" do
      expect(ToolRegistry.options_for("pdf_to_text")).to eq([])
    end
  end
end

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe SeoHelper, type: :helper do

        double(path: "/tools/merge-pdf?utm_source=email")
      )
      expect(helper.canonical_url).to eq("https://officedoctools.com/tools/merge-pdf")
    end

    it "uses the explicit path argument over request.path" do
      expect(helper.canonical_url("/about")).to eq("https://officedoctools.com/about")
    end
  end

  describe "#breadcrumb_schema" do
    it "returns a valid BreadcrumbList structure" do
      schema = helper.breadcrumb_schema([["Home", "https://x.com/"], ["Tools", "https://x.com/tools"]])
      expect(schema["@type"]).to eq("BreadcrumbList")
      expect(schema["itemListElement"].size).to eq(2)
      expect(schema["itemListElement"][0]["position"]).to eq(1)
      expect(schema["itemListElement"][1]["name"]).to eq("Tools")
    end
  end

  describe "#faq_schema" do
    it "returns a valid FAQPage structure" do
      schema = helper.faq_schema([["Is it free?", "Yes."]])
      expect(schema["@type"]).to eq("FAQPage")
      expect(schema["mainEntity"][0]["name"]).to eq("Is it free?")
      expect(schema["mainEntity"][0]["acceptedAnswer"]["text"]).to eq("Yes.")
    end
  end

  describe "#tool_seo" do
    let(:tool) { ToolRegistry.find("compress_pdf") }

    it "generates title, description, and faq" do

      expect(seo[:title]).to include("Compress PDF")
      expect(seo[:description].length).to be <= 158
      expect(seo[:faq]).to be_an(Array)
      expect(seo[:faq].first[0]).to match(/free/i)
    end

    it "marks premium tools with upgrade language in the faq" do
      ocr = ToolRegistry.find("ocr_pdf")
      seo = helper.tool_seo(ocr)
      expect(seo[:faq].first[1]).to include("Pro")
    end
  end
end
